newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks end softer, mood bearish.
newsitem.headline: French stocks end softer, mood bearish.

text.p: French shares ended weaker on Friday amid continued bearish sentiment over the French budget and labour outlook and expected poor corporate results.

The blue-chip CAC-40 index finished down 6.95 points or 0.35 percent at 1,970.61, and was down nearly 50 points on the week. The CAC-40 futures contract finished unchanged at 1978 while the broader SBF-20 index ended 3.81 points lower at 1,396.
"The labour climate is not very good. The franc is weak. The half-year corporate earnings results won't be great. There's not much grounds for optimism for next week," said one dealer.
Volume was a heavy five billion francs, inflated by trading related to the expiry of futures and options on Friday.

Alcatel Alsthom rose 0.31 percent to 392 francs. It said its GEC Alsthom venture with Britain's GEC was studying a possible merger with state-controlled nuclear reactor builder Framatome. Alcatel has long sought to regain control of Framatome.
